stage: Working tree; no release, commit, push or installation.
feature: Two-finger pan and centroid-anchored pinch with independent camera math and guarded renderer sessions.
behavior: Explicit touch pointers promote the existing single-finger gesture; mouse and single-finger behavior stays available.
Target-depth world position follows the two-finger midpoint in both projections; heading remains unchanged. Perspective other depths retain parallax.
Input-driven animation frames combine the latest pair coordinates before one atomic draw and reference update. Normal up flushes pending input; cancellation discards it.
Either release ends the pair, with no residual selection or drag. Third pointers, mixed input, capture loss, view changes and disposal cancel owned pending work.
Focused bounds remain authoritative. Distant authored cameras outside the usual interval receive a locked proportional gesture range, avoiding a starting jump.
Only explicitly supported renderers show three-language touch instructions; no author text, save, Rust ABI, schema, backend or Studio capability changes.

earlierProofs.reason: Initial normal navigation proof passed. Independent review then found legal distant authored cameras snapped into the default distance range; added locked gesture bounds and regression cases.

Distant and near-minimum camera proof passed. Review of exact zoom limits found serial pointer updates could introduce small unwanted zoom during translation; frame coalescing and exact-limit checks were added.

limitations: No two-finger twist, inertia or author-object manipulation.
Browser software WebGL2 and touch emulation do not establish hardware-GPU, installed desktop or Android-device support.
Targeted regression only; no full application or Rust suite rerun.
Prepared resources are temporary; no installer built or installed.
